Photorealistic.description: Extremely lifelike rendering, indistinguishable from a high-quality photograph.

Oil Painting.description: Rich, textured brushstrokes and blended pigments in the style of classical oil paint.

Watercolor.description: Soft, translucent washes of color with visible paper texture and gentle bleeding.

Digital Art.description: Clean, polished illustration created with digital painting tools.

Pixel Art.description: Retro-style artwork composed of visible square pixels, common in classic video games.

Vector Art.description: Crisp, scalable shapes with flat colors and clean outlines.

Anime.description: Japanese animation style with expressive eyes, clean lines, and stylized shading.

Manga.description: Black-and-white Japanese comic style with screentone shading and dynamic linework.

Comic Book.description: Bold outlines, halftone dots, and vivid colors in the style of Western comics.

Sketch.description: Loose pencil or ink linework with an unfinished, hand-drawn feel.

Line Art.description: Clean, minimal artwork built purely from outlines without shading.

Low Poly.description: Stylized 3D look built from a small number of flat polygonal facets.

Concept Art.description: Polished illustrative artwork used for film/game pre-production, often moody and cinematic.

Matte Painting.description: Photorealistic painted environment, traditionally used as a film backdrop.

Charcoal Drawing.description: Smudgy, high-contrast monochrome drawing with deep blacks and soft gradients.

Acrylic Painting.description: Bold, fast-drying paint with vibrant flat or layered color.

Ukiyo-e.description: Japanese woodblock print style with flat color areas and flowing contour lines.

Stained Glass.description: Colored sections separated by dark lead lines, like a cathedral window.

Matte.description: A non-reflective surface that diffuses light evenly.

Metallic.description: A shiny and reflective surface that mimics metal properties.

Glossy.description: A smooth, polished surface with sharp, bright reflections.

Glass.description: Transparent or translucent material with refraction and specular highlights.

Bark-like.description: A rough, textured surface resembling tree bark.

Wooden.description: Warm organic texture with visible grain and knots.

Marble.description: Smooth stone with elegant veining patterns.

Rusty.description: Oxidized, corroded metal with orange-brown patina and flaking texture.

Velvet.description: Soft, plush fabric with a dense light-absorbing pile.

Iridescent.description: Surface that shifts color depending on viewing angle, like a soap bubble.

Holographic.description: Rainbow-shifting reflective surface with futuristic shimmer.

Brushed Metal.description: Metal with fine parallel scratches giving a dull satin sheen.

Ceramic.description: Glazed pottery surface — smooth, hard, and slightly glossy.

Paper Mache.description: Rough, layered paper texture with a handmade feel.

Isometric.description: A 3D-like perspective where all axes are equally foreshortened at 120-degree angles; common in strategy games and pixel art.

Dimetric.description: A perspective similar to isometric but with two axes foreshortened unequally.

Bird's Eye View.description: A top-down perspective looking directly down onto a scene.

Worm's Eye View.description: Viewed from ground level looking up, making subjects appear towering.

Wide Angle.description: Expansive field of view with slight distortion, capturing more of the scene.

Macro.description: Extreme close-up revealing tiny details invisible to the naked eye.

Fisheye.description: Ultra-wide lens look with strong curved distortion at the edges.

Dutch Angle.description: Tilted horizon line creating tension and dynamism.

Over-the-Shoulder.description: Framed from behind a subject's shoulder, common in film and games.

Symmetrical.description: Perfectly mirrored composition around a central axis.

Golden Hour.description: Warm, soft sunlight shortly after sunrise or before sunset.

Neon Lighting.description: Glowing colored light, often pink/cyan, with a cyberpunk feel.

Chiaroscuro.description: Strong contrast between light and dark for dramatic depth, like Caravaggio.

Backlit.description: Subject lit from behind, creating a glowing rim and silhouetted front.

Soft Diffused.description: Even, gentle light with no harsh shadows, like an overcast day.

Volumetric.description: Visible rays of light through fog or dust (god rays).

Bioluminescent.description: Organic glowing light emitted by the subject itself.

Studio Lighting.description: Controlled, professional three-point lighting with clean shadows.

Candlelit.description: Warm, flickering light with deep surrounding shadows.

Dreamy.description: Soft, hazy, and ethereal with a gentle idealized feel.

Eerie.description: Unsettling and mysterious, on the edge of unsettling.

Melancholic.description: Quietly sad and reflective, often with muted tones.

Utopian.description: Idealized, perfect world — clean, bright, harmonious.

Nostalgic.description: Warm memory-evoking feel, often with vintage color grading.

Surreal.description: Illogical, dreamlike juxtapositions in the style of Dalí or Magritte.

Pastel.description: Soft, pale, desaturated colors with a gentle feel.

Vaporwave.description: Neon pinks, purples, and cyans with retro 80s/90s nostalgia.

Earthy Tones.description: Warm browns, greens, and ochres inspired by nature.

Duotone.description: Image rendered in only two contrasting colors.

Neon Palette.description: Saturated electric colors against dark backgrounds.

Sepia.description: Warm brown-tinted tones like an aged photograph.

Complementary.description: Colors opposite each other on the color wheel (e.g. teal & orange) for strong contrast.

Analogous.description: Neighboring hues on the color wheel for harmonious blending.

Cyberpunk.description: High-tech dystopia with neon, rain, and sprawling megacities.

Steampunk.description: Victorian-era technology powered by steam, brass, and gears.

Retro Futurism.description: The future as imagined in the 1950s-70s — chrome, fins, atomic motifs.

Medieval.description: Castles, knights, and rustic villages of the Middle Ages.

Art Deco.description: 1920s glamour with geometric patterns, gold, and symmetry.

Solarpunk.description: Optimistic green future with lush vegetation and sustainable tech.

Dieselpunk.description: Gritty interwar-era tech aesthetic with heavy machinery.

Baroque.description: Ornate 17th-century opulence with dramatic movement and gold detail.

Gritty.description: Rough, dirty, realistic texture with grime and wear.

Weathered.description: Aged by exposure — faded, cracked, and worn.

Glitchy.description: Digital corruption artifacts — color fringing, scanlines, datamosh.

Bokeh.description: Soft blurred background points of light from shallow depth of field.

Vignette.description: Darkened edges drawing focus to the center.

Film Grain.description: Analog camera noise giving a textured, cinematic feel.

Motion Blur.description: Streaking along the direction of movement to imply speed.

Lens Flare.description: Bright light scattering rings and streaks across the frame.

Double Exposure.description: Two images blended into one, like overlapping film photos.
